items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: On the PBS special, we had his – Wilson, I think was . . . Teddy Wilson. ... So I started playing my Charlie Christian style solo. ... Now Teddy Wilson goes [unseen gesture]. Now he’s alive. The whole band started looking at me now.
